without_views.sql:
SELECT
  seagate_production_lines.drive_family AS Drive_Family,
  SUM(seagate_production_events.units_completed) AS Patties_Plated
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_lines
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ON seagate_production_lines.line_code = seagate_production_events.work_order_id::TEXT
WHERE seagate_production_lines.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY seagate_production_lines.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN test.result = 'pass' AND test.garnish_defect = FALSE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(test.test_id), 0)) AS golden_yield
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_quality_tests AS test
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS sku ON test.work_order_id = sku.sku_id
WHERE sku.drive_family = 'Vantage'
  AND test.tested_at >= '2025-10-01'
  AND test.tested_at < '2026-01-01'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  ss.destination_region AS region,
  SUM(ss.qty_units) AS combo_pallet_dine_in_units,
  AVG(sqt.result) AS golden_yield
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_shipments ss
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sds ON ss.work_order_id = sds.sku_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_quality_tests sqt ON ss.work_order_id = sqt.work_order_id
WHERE sds.drive_family = 'Nimbus'
  AND ss.pallet_type = 'Combo-pallet Dine-In'
  AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM ss.ship_date) = 2025
  AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM ss.ship_date) = 4
  AND ss.destination_region IN ('Tigerline', 'Reef')
  AND sqt.test_type = 'Golden Yield'
GROUP BY ss.desti

SELECT seagate_production_lines.drive_family AS drive_family,
       SUM(seagate_production_events.units_completed) AS total_patties_plated
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_production_events
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines
  ON seagate_production_events.work_order_id = seagate_production_lines.line_id
WHERE seagate_production_lines.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY seagate_production_lines.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT
  (SUM(CASE WHEN st.result = 'Pass' AND st.test_type = 'Golden Yield' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)::FLOAT / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN st.test_type = 'Golden Yield' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END),0)) AS golden_yield
FROM
  seagate_core.seagate_quality_tests st
JOIN
  seagate_core.seagate_work_orders wo ON st.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
JOIN
  seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sku ON wo.sku_id = sku.sku_id
WHERE
  sku.drive_family = 'Vantage'
  AND st.test_type = 'Golden Yield'
  AND st.tested_at >= '2025-10-01'
  AND st.tested_at < '2026-01-01'
LIMIT 1

SELECT
  shipment.destination_region AS region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN drive_sku.drive_family = 'Nimbus' AND shipment.pallet_type = 'Combo-pallet' AND shipment.fulfillment_type = 'Dine-In' THEN shipment.qty_units ELSE 0 END) AS combo_pallet_dine_in_units,
  AVG(CASE WHEN shipment.destination_region IN ('Tigerline', 'Reef') THEN shipment.qty_units * 1.0 / NULLIF(NULL,0) ELSE NULL END) AS golden_yield -- Placeholder, no golden yield definition or columns available
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_shipments AS shipment
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus AS drive_sku ON shipment.work_order_id = drive_sku.sku_i

SELECT sku.drive_family, SUM(ev.units_completed) AS patties_plated
FROM seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sku
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_work_orders wo ON wo.sku_id = sku.sku_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines ln ON ln.line_id = wo.line_id
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ev ON ev.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
WHERE ln.status = 'WARM'
GROUP BY sku.drive_family
LIMIT 100

SELECT sku.drive_family, 
       SUM(ev.units_completed - ev.units_scrapped - ev.units_reworked) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ev.units_completed), 0) AS golden_yield
FROM seagate_core.seagate_production_events ev
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_work_orders wo ON wo.work_order_id = ev.work_order_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sku ON sku.sku_id = wo.sku_id
WHERE wo.ticket_type = 'STANDARD'
  AND sku.drive_family = 'Vantage'
  AND ev.event_date >= '2025-10-01' AND ev.event_date <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY sku.drive_family
LIMIT 10

JOIN seagate_core.seagate_work_orders wo ON wo.sku_id = sku.sku_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_production_lines ln ON ln.line_id = wo.line_id
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ev ON ev.work_order_id = wo.work_order_id
WHERE ln.status = 'WARM'

SELECT
  sku.drive_family,
  SUM(ev.units_completed - ev.units_scrapped - ev.units_reworked) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(ev.units_completed), 0) AS golden_yield
FROM seagate_ops.seagate_production_events ev
JOIN seagate_ops.seagate_work_orders wo ON wo.work_order_id = ev.work_order_id
JOIN seagate_core.seagate_drive_skus sku ON sku.sku_id = wo.sku_id
WHERE wo.ticket_type = 'STANDARD'
  AND sku.drive_family = 'Vantage'
  AND ev.event_date >= '2025-10-01'
  AND ev.event_date <= '2025-12-31'
GROUP BY sku.drive_family
LIMIT 1
